## Portrait on iPhone and iPad

- Starlight now turns with your iPhone or iPad. Streams are always landscape: pressing Play with the device upright turns the screen first.
- iPhone upright: the carousel takes the top of the screen (Apple TV app proportion) with everything centred; Library shows three posters per row and the filter sits above the sort.
- Library and Search posters fill the width at any size and recalculate when the device turns.

## iPad

- Fills the screen upright too (it used to stay landscape with black bars).
- **Tab bar or sidebar**: the button at the left of the tab bar turns it into a sidebar, like the Apple TV app (iPadOS keeps your choice).
- Scrolling down a tab brings in the glass bar; scrolling further hides the tab bar and the tab's title (Play Now, Library, Settings, Search) fades in on the glass. The tab bar comes back when you scroll up or reach the top.
- Carousel: logo, text and buttons on the left (the dots stay centred), like the Apple TV app on iPad.

## Search

- Before you type, Search shows your recent searches and two rows (Recently Played, Ready to Play) instead of repeating the Library. Results appear as you type. A search is remembered when you submit it or open one of its results; **Clear** forgets them.

## Details

- iPhone game page: the logo, PC and hours, Play, ••• and the playtime stats are centred, in line with the carousel.
- The game page's ••• is now the same round glass button as the carousel's.
- The trailer's sound button is white, like the other icons at the top right.
- iPad Search: the search field is always open at the top and gets the keyboard as soon as you open the tab (no second magnifier).
- iPad with the sidebar: the sidebar floats over the carousel and game page art, which stays edge to edge, while the logo, text, buttons and rows move clear of it. The carousel trailer keeps playing, and an open game page stays open, when you show or hide the sidebar.

## Top bar

- The PC button and the status (time, controller, network, battery) are now one capsule; tapping it opens the PC menu. The trailer's sound button sits in the same capsule. Settings has it too.
- iPhone: the screen's title (Play Now, Library, Settings, Search) sits on the left when upright and in the centre in landscape.
- iPhone upright: the iOS status bar (time, signal, battery) is back at the top, and the capsule shows just the PC (and the sound button during a trailer).

## Connecting in the background

- Opening Starlight with the PC asleep or unreachable no longer freezes the app behind a spinner: finding the PC, waking it and loading its games happen in the background, so you can keep browsing.
- Meanwhile the PC button shows an animated "in progress" symbol in place of the PC. It switches back to the PC (with its online dot) once the PC answers, or after a minute of waking without a reply.

## iPad sidebar

- With the sidebar showing (like the Apple TV app): Search comes first, and a **PCs** section lists your PCs with their state (Online, Offline, or Connecting… with the animated symbol). Tap one to switch; touch and hold to wake it or refresh its games; **Add PC by Address…** sits at the end.
- The top bar then has no glass or title (the sidebar shows where you are), and the top-right capsule keeps only the time, controller, network, battery and the trailer's sound button.
